Today, as the region's largest healthcare facility and home to the only Level I Trauma Center in the area, the 492-bed, faith-based acute care hospital provides advanced specialty services and lifesaving care for patients across the region. Fully accredited by The Joint Commission (TJC), the hospital is committed to delivering exceptional care through advanced technology, clinical excellence and a compassionate approach to healing. Shuttle Details (BMCS Campus Only): Valet Services will be discontinued by the end of July-2026. Please note: We are in the process of updating signage and other materials that may reference valet services. Shuttle Services will be available Monday - Friday, 5:30 a.m. – 9:30 p.m. This is a FREE service for all patients and visitors. The Shuttle will cover all parking lots to provide patients and visitors convenient access to the main entrances. To access the shuttle, please call hpt-obf:v1:AlYn0ymf6crkXwUW.y34-zAhU2cy9wn6Ksw_W5g.TLrE0Ud-hwD5rhWEgRk. If the patient has a driver, the driver can drop off the patient at the front entrance of the hospital. The driver is then able to park their vehicle and request the shuttle to pick them up and bring them to the door. If the patient is the driver, the patient may park their vehicle and request shuttle pick up. Healthcare Services & Specialties Baptist Medical Center South is known for outstanding cardiovascular, orthopaedic, neurology and surgical services. Additionally, the hospital offers a variety of specialized services for patients of all ages, including: Behavioral Health Facility: providing psychiatric services in a safe and empowering setting Chest Pain Center: located within the emergency department to provide rapid response care for cardiac events Family-Centered Maternity Care: making the birthing experience as special as it should be Regional NICU: offering specialized, around-the-clock for premature and critically ill newborns Sleep Disorders Center: accredited facility to diagnose and treat sleep apnea, insomnia and other disruptive conditions Hospice Care: offering a comprehensive plan of care to allow patients and their families to add more life to every day Interactive Map Our goal is to make your visit with us as easy and stress-free as possible.
